diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in 'false' for all content checks, meaning no decision-maker was able to correctly identify any of the required outcomes. The model consistently defaulted to routine or pending statuses (e.g., 'Routine referral process', 'Pending financial counseling report') because it lacked access to the decisive facts (PF1, PF2, PF3, PF4) and could not infer them from the shared public information.
